title: fix(components): the sort builder words a numeric sort direction as size
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Fixes #37027

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 列表「全部排序层级」和手机上的排序面板里,数字、百分比、进度、金额字段的方向选项从「A → Z / Z → A」改为「小 → 大 / 大 → 小」;日期仍是「最早 → 最新」,文本仍是字母序。
- 列表页重做专题的里程碑验收发现的显示错误,让排序方向的说法与字段类型一致。
- 出错时只是方向文字不对,排序结果本身不变;可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `SortBuilder` (`ui/packages/components/src/custom/sort-builder.tsx`) had its own direction table that knew only `date` / `datetime`, so every other type read "A → Z". It now words a level by a module-local `sortWording` + `sortDirectionLabel` (no new package export): date-like types (`FILTER_DATE_LIKE_TYPES`) read as time, the spec's numeric family (`FILTER_NUMBER_LIKE_TYPES`: number, currency, percent, rating, slider, progress, summary) plus boolean as size, anything else as the alphabet, over the `listConditions.sort.{time,size,alphabet}_{asc,desc}` rows every locale already carries. No i18n key is added.
- The phone sort sheet's levels (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/phone/PhoneListPanels.tsx`) had the same date-only table over `sortBuilder.*` keys. They now read `sortDirectionLabel` from `plugin-list`'s `conditions/conditionModel.ts` (an internal module, not a package export), with the same three-way rule and the same keys. The list's former `sortWording` / `ListConditionControls.sortDirectionLabel` pair, which had no non-test caller, is folded into that one helper.
- Trade-off, stated: the rule lives twice, module-local in `@object-ui/components` and in `plugin-list`'s condition model, both over the same `@object-ui/types` type lists and the same locale keys. One copy would need a new published export from `@object-ui/components` (or `@object-ui/types`), which would make this `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- `plugin-list`'s provider-less defaults drop the four `sortBuilder.ascending/descending/oldestFirst/newestFirst` rows. The matching locale rows in `@object-ui/i18n` now have no reader in this repo (`check:i18n-dead-keys` lists them) but are left in place: removing rows from the published `./locales/*` packs would be a narrowing.

## Tests
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/sort-builder-date-direction-duplicates-27520.test.tsx`, new describe: number, progress, percent and currency rows offer "Low → High" / "High → Low"; CONTROL: date keeps time, text keeps the alphabet. It also replaces the removed plugin-list unit test of the dead helper (same date / currency / text assertions, on the live component).
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.phonePanels-35884.test.tsx`, new describe on the real phone `ListView`: number, progress, percent and currency levels read "Low → High"; CONTROL: date reads as time, text as the alphabet.

## Acceptance notes
- Browser check in the showcase app (zh-CN, `showcase_task`, desktop and phone width) was not run: the verify lock was held by other runs for the whole window. The DOM tests above drive the real components.
